name: Draft
next_step_note: Complete all required fields and submit your application for review.

name: Submitted
next_step_note: Your application has been received. Please wait while it is assigned for document verification.

name: Under Verification
next_step_note: Your documents are currently being reviewed. No action is required at this stage.

name: Verified
next_step_note: Your application has been successfully verified. Proceed to pay the required programme fee.

name: Fee Paid
next_step_note: Your payment has been confirmed. Your admission is being processed and the offer letter will be issued shortly.

name: Returned for Correction
next_step_note: Your application requires corrections. Please review the remarks, update the necessary details, and resubmit your application.

name: Rejected
next_step_note: Your application has been rejected. Please refer to the remarks for details. You may contact the admissions team for further clarification.

name: Enrolled
next_step_note: Application has been converted to student. Admission process complete.
